what: Keys, directions and a worked traversal for the graph configs of the Hugging Face export.
why: Audit finding F5 (2026-09-10): the dedicated graph files existed but the card gave no complete join recipe, and file presence alone does not establish referential integrity. This document gives the keys and reports a validation run.

nodes.note: the universal object registry; every relation endpoint resolves here

relations.direction: source --predicate--> target; the predicate reads left to right
relations.note: relation_id is content-derived and stable across rebuilds and machines

assertions.cardinality: one assertion per relation in this build; the shape permits many
assertions.note: an edge is WHAT is claimed; an assertion is WHO claimed it, in what act, on what basis, and whether it still stands

memberships.note: a membership is not an edge: it carries slot, role and TOPOLOGY — inside, outside, inside-and-outside, position-not-occupant

frames.note: the arrangement under which memberships take a configuration

pessoagraph.note: IMPORTED AS ITS OWN BODY with its own namespace; NOT joinable to nodes.node_id directly

graph_join.note: the only bridge between the two namespaces; 22 of 26 identities join, 175 lineage nodes do not and that is correct

citations.note: deposit-level citation edges, kept as their own config; the same relations also appear in `relations` under predicate `cites`. A consumer wanting one representation should use `relations` and filter.

status_propagation: relations.status derives from the endpoints' deposit status. `supersedes` is exempt: it points at a superseded record by definition.

repairs_this_build: agent nodes registered (111 previously unresolvable targets)
mantle prefix aligned to datasets/frames, the canonical store (7 memberships)
orthonymic_relation targets resolved through the record's own identity_type (12)

worked_traversal.note: run against this build, not illustrative
